title: Inversion and Emphasis / Inversion fi Emphasis
bridge: Afan Ingilizii keessatti, jijjiirama kana malee kan hin qabne garuu, akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa qabda. Haa’uun barbaachisaa qabnyatee akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa qabda, akkasumas ‘not only... but also’ kana ‘so + adjective... that’ akkasii hojjettiin barbaachisaa qabda. Afaan Ispeenii keessatti, haa’uun barbaachisaa qabnyatee akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa hin qabne garuu, akkasumas gabaabsaa fi hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda. Akkasumas, ‘Not only he arrived late’ hin seera ‘Not only did he arrive late’ jedhanii akkasii haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda.
rule: Afan Ingilizii keessatti, haa’uun barbaachisaa qabnyatee akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa qabda. Haa’uun barbaachisaa qabnyatee akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa qabda: 1) ‘never’, ‘rarely’, ‘seldom’, ‘hardly’, ‘scarcely’, ‘no sooner’, ‘not only’, ‘not until’, ‘little’, ‘in no way’ akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda. Haa’uun barbaachisaa qabnyatee akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa qabda, akkasumas ‘do/does/did’, ‘have/has’, ‘will’ akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda. 2) ‘so + adjective/adverb’ fi ‘such + noun’ akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda, akkasumas ‘that’ (haa’uun ‘that’ hin qabne garuu) akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda. 3) ‘not only... but also’, ‘only after’, ‘only if’ akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda. 4) ‘if’ hin qabne garuu, haa’uun barbaachisaa qabnyatee akkas haa’uu isaanii hojii barbaachisaa qabda. 5) ‘here’ fi ‘there’ akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda, akkasumas ‘may’ (gabaabsaa) akkasii hojjettiin haa’uun barbaachisaa qabda.

title: Advanced Inversion and Fronting / Inversioniin fi Frontalizationii Adda Ta’e
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, inversion (qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan) himaa malee walitti dhuunfatu, kan biraa isaan irra deebii kennuufi qajeelfamni dubbii akka ta’eefi godheera. Afaan Oromoo keessatti, qajeelfamni kun qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan hin kennamne garuu, qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan hin kennamne garuu, qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan hin kennamne garuu, qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan hin kennamne. Fakkeenya: 'Rarely have I seen such beauty' afaan Oromoo keessatti 'Rara vez he visto tal belleza' jedhaa, inversion hin kennamne. Gahiisa uumame tokko akkasii: afaan Oromoo keessatti inversion sirrii walitti dhuunfatu hin qabne garuu, afaan Ingilizii keessatti walitti dhuunfatu irra deebi’an akkasumas walitti dhuunfatu irra deebi’an akkasumas walitti dhuunfatu irra deebi’an. Haala malee: barbaachisaa akkamii hin qabne garuu, barbaachisaa akkamii hin qabne garuu, barbaachisaa akkamii hin qabne garuu.
rule: Inversioniin afaan Ingilizii keessatti akkasii godhatama: qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan (adverbs negative, expressions of restriction, fi adverbs of frequency with negative connotation) walitti dhuunfatu. Kana malees, qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan (fi verb 'be') akkaan ajjee jiraatan, sirrii walitti dhuunfatu. Fakkeenya: 1) Adverbs negative: 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'barely', 'no sooner' - fakkeenya: 'Never have I seen such a mess'. 2) Expressions of restriction: 'not only...but also', 'only after', 'only by', 'only when' - fakkeenya: 'Only after the war did they return'. 3) Expressions of frequency with 'so' fi 'such' - fakkeenya: 'So beautiful was the sunset that we stopped'. 4) 'Not until' fi 'not since' - fakkeenya: 'Not until midnight did the party end'. 5) 'In no way', 'on no account', 'under no circumstances'. Akkasumas: auxiliary hin qabne garuu, 'do/does/did' present fi simple past keessatti inversion kennu. Inversioniin qajeelfamni dubbii fi barra biraa keessatti godhatama; gara fuulaa keessatti hin godhamne garuu, qajeelfamni dubbii keessatti godhatama. 'Frontalization' hin kennamne garuu, qopheessaa baafameera akkaan ajjee jiraatan akkasumas walitti dhuunfatu, sirrii walitti dhuunfatu, fakkeenya: 'That book I would never read' (kan 'I would never read that book' jiraatan).

title: Ellipsis and Substitution (so do I, neither have we) / Lafa qopheessaa fi qajeelfama
bridge: Afaan Oromoo, kan verb dubbifama kana ‘hame’ fi ‘hamee’ hin qabne garuu, afaan Ingiliffaa kan verb dubbifama kana ‘do/does/did’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna. Kana malee, afaan Oromoo ‘so do I’ kana ‘neither have we’ jechuun isaan hin qabne garuu, kun kan afaan Ingiliffaa qajeelfama qopheessaa qabdu yeroo sanatti dhaga’aa fi hawaasaa deebii akkas jestu godha. Kana malee, afaan Oromoo ‘so do I’ kana ‘neither have we’ jechuun isaan hin qabne garuu, kun kan afaan Ingiliffaa qajeelfama qopheessaa qabdu yeroo sanatti dhaga’aa fi hawaasaa deebii akkas jestu godha.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa, lafa qopheessaa fi qajeelfama yeroo sanatti dubbii qabdu kan verb dubbifama kana ‘so’ fi ‘neither/nor’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna. Yeroo kan verb dubbifama kana ‘so’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna, ‘so + verb dubbifama + gaaffii’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna (e.g., ‘So do I’). Yeroo kan verb dubbifama kana ‘neither/nor’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna, ‘neither/nor + verb dubbifama + gaaffii’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna (e.g., ‘Neither have we’). Akkasumas, ‘do/does/did’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna kan verb dubbifama kana (e.g., ‘She speaks French better than I do’), fi ‘so’ jechuun isaan argachuu qabna kan dubbii qabdu kana (e.g., ‘I think so’). Afaan Ingiliffii bakkaa, ‘also’ kana ‘too’ jechuun isaan hin arginu garuu, verb dubbifama qabaachuun qabna.

title: Advanced Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan
bridge: Afaan Oromo, miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan ol ta’ee ‘no obstante’, ‘por consiguiente’ fi ‘a saber’ kan ta’an, seenaa walitti dhaabbatanii ingilizifoonni dhaabbatanis. Hata’a, afaan Ingilizii keessaa miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan walitti dhaabbatanis yookiin murtii dhaabbatanis, kanarratti kan malee ta’uudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessaa miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan ‘though’ murtii dhaabbatanis akkasumas afaan Oromoofi dhaabbatanis akkasii hin qabne akkasumas dhaga’uudha. Haala dhaabbataa fi haala murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan ittiin hin kennamne.
rule: Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan afaan Ingilizii (C1) kan ittiin hojjatan: 1) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘nevertheless’, ‘nonetheless’, ‘whereas’, ‘while’, ‘on the contrary’, ‘in contrast’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas ‘whereas’ fi ‘while’ clauserraa hin deebisan). 2) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘consequently’, ‘therefore’, ‘thus’, ‘hence’, ‘accordingly’, ‘as a result’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas ‘thus’ fi ‘hence’ dhaabbatanis akkasumas isinii yookiin participle hin deebisan). 3) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘furthermore’, ‘moreover’, ‘in addition’, ‘besides’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas ‘besides’ dhaabbatanis akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis). 4) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘in other words’, ‘that is’, ‘namely’, ‘to put it differently’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis). 5) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘for instance’, ‘for example’, ‘such as’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis). 6) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘incidentally’, ‘by the way’, ‘meanwhile’, ‘in the meantime’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis yookiin hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan). 7) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘admittedly’, ‘granted’, ‘even though’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis). 8) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘indeed’, ‘in fact’, ‘actually’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis). 9) Miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan: ‘in conclusion’, ‘to sum up’, ‘in summary’, ‘ultimately’ (kan ittiin hojjatan akkasumas gaaffii walitti dhaabbatanis). Walitti dhaabbatan, komaa hin deebisan; murtii dhaabbatan, komaa hin deebisan; murtii dhaabbatan, ‘though’ komaa hin deebisan. Afaan Oromo, miilla murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan ‘sin embargo’, ‘no obstante’, ‘además’, ‘por lo tanto’, ‘es decir’, ‘por ejemplo’ hin deebisan, haala dhaabbataa fi haala murtii dhaabbataa hojii irra deebi’anii guddaan ittiin hin kennamne.

title: Hedging and Tentativeness / Matización i distanciamiento
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, fannoo epistemic qajeelfama isaaniin adabbiwwan ‘might’ kana ‘could’ dubbii isaaniitti dhiisiisuu danda’a. Afaan Ispeeni keessatti garuu, fannoo kana malee fannoo subjunctive isaaniin adabbiwwan ‘quizás’ kana ‘posiblemente’ dubbii isaaniitti dhiisiisuu danda’a. Akkasumas, afaan Ingilizii keessatti fannoonni kun qajeelfama isaaniin durii tokko ilaalchisee dhiisuu danda’a, afaan Ispeeni keessatti garuu, fannoonni kun malees jiraatanii erga dubbii isaaniif kennamu. Akkasumas, afaan Ingilizii keessatti fannoonni kun qajeelfama isaaniin durii tokko ilaalchisee dhiisuu danda’a, afaan Ispeeni keessatti garuu, fannoonni kun malees jiraatanii erga dubbii isaaniif kennamu.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, hedging (matización) fannoonni kun qajeelfama isaaniin dhiisuu danda’a:
- Adabbiwwan fannoo: may, might, could (dhiheessuu), should (dhiheessuu qajeelfama).
- Adabbiwwan dubbii: perhaps, possibly, presumably, arguably, maybe.
- Adabbiwwan maqaa fi suurrii: I think, I believe, I suppose, I would say, I tend to think.
- Fannoonni impersonal fi passive: It is often said that, It is widely believed that.
- Adabbiwwan dubbii: possible, likely, unlikely, debatable, questionable.
- Fannoo hin baasiin fannoo: Would you mind... I wondered...
- C1 keessatti, fannoonni kun qajeelfama isaaniin dhiisuu danda’a: 'might' dhiheessuu kan qajeelfamne ‘may’; 'could' dhiheessuu kan qajeelfamne 'should'.

title: Complex Verb Patterns: Double Objects / Qorrummaa Mataa’eessa: Lamaaf Baasuu
bridge: Afaan Oromoo, mana qorrummaa mataa’eessaan ‘isiin’ jechuunis obbolaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hojjedha. Afaan Ingilifiz, qorrummaa mataa’eessaan lamaaf baasuu dha. ‘Give something to somebody’ jechuun ‘give somebody something’ jechuunis dha. Haata’u malee, qorrummaa mataa’eessaan lamaaf baasuu hin dandeenye. Afaan Ingilifiz, lamaaf baasuu hin jiran obboleen mataa’eessanii harmaa barbaachisaa dha. Qorrummaa ‘explain’ jechuun ‘suggest’ jechuunis lamaaf baasuu hin dandeenye. Afaan Oromoo, ‘explícame’ jechuun haala malee dha.
rule: Afaan Ingilifiz, qorrummaa mataa’eessaan lamaaf baasuu dha. (1) Qorrummaa + lamaaf baasuu (person) + mataa’eessanii (thing) — ‘give John a book’ — (2) Qorrummaa + mataa’eessanii + ‘to/for’ + lamaaf baasuu — ‘give a book to John’. Qorrummaa mataa’eessaan lamaaf baasuu hin dandeenye. Qorrummaa ‘give’, ‘send’, ‘show’, ‘tell’, ‘teach’, ‘lend’, ‘pass’, ‘offer’, ‘owe’, ‘promise’ lamaaf baasuu dha. Qorrummaa ‘explain’, ‘describe’, ‘suggest’, ‘mention’, ‘announce’, ‘report’, ‘say’, ‘admit’, ‘confess’ ‘to’ jechuun lamaaf baasuu hin dandeenye. ‘Buy’, ‘get’, ‘make’, ‘cook’, ‘find’, ‘save’ jechuunis ‘for’ jechuun dha (e.g., ‘buy a gift for her’ jechuun ‘buy her a gift’). Mataa’eessanii pronoum jechuu (it, them), ‘give it to me’ jechuun ‘give me it’ jechuu dha. Qorrummaa ‘provide somebody with something’ jechuun ‘explain something to somebody’ jechuunis dha.

title: Nuances of Tense and Aspect / Matices hin deemanii fi qooda afaan Oromo
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffaa, deemanii perfective fi imperfective hin jiru malee, deemanii kun galgalaa jiraataa hojii keessatti argama (simple past vs. past progressive), afaan Ispeenichii gatiin deemanii kun galgalaa jiraachuu barbaachisaa ta'e hojii keessatti malee hin jiru. Qorophaa akkamii akkas jedhanii Ispeenichaa afaan hunda beekuu qaban isaanii waan tokkoon malee hin kennamne (f.y 'I worked' hanga 'I was working' jechuu) yookiin hawaasaa present perfect (he comido) fi simple past (comí) hin kennamne. Qorophaa akkamii akkas jedhanii Ingiliffaa 'past perfect' hin jiru malee, afaan Ispeenichii gatiin 'pretérito pluscuamperfecto' hin jiru, hojii keessatti deebi’anii dhaabbataa ta'e hojii keessatti malee hin jiru.
rule: 1. **Progressive vs. Simple Aspect**: Afaan Ingiliffaa, present progressive (am/is/are + -ing) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, present simple (base form, -s hin jiran third person) gatiin hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. Hojii keessatti, 'was/were + -ing' hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, simple past (verb + -ed yookiin irregular) gatiin hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. 2. **Perfect Aspects**: 'Present perfect' (have/has + -ed) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, 'past perfect' (had + -ed) gatiin hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. Afaan Ispeenichii gatiin, present perfect (he hecho) fi pluscuamperfecto (había hecho) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. 3. **Stative verbs** (like, know, believe, want): hojii keessatti hin kennamne; garuu, tokko tokko qooda deebi’anii wal hin qabne (f.y 'be having' vs. 'have'). 4. **Expressing Future**: Afaan Ingiliffaa, present continuous (hojii keessatti hojjechuu), 'be going to' (hojii keessatti hojjechuu), fi 'will' (hojii keessatti hojjechuu) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. 5. **Aspect with 'used to' and 'would'**: Hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, 'used to' (solía) yookiin 'would' (solía) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. 6. **Narración**: Hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, simple past (hojii keessatti hojjechuu) fi past progressive (hojii keessatti hojjechuu) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. Past perfect hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. Afaan Ispeenichii gatiin deemanii hin jiru.

common_error.correct: I have been working here since 2010.
common_error.explanation: Qorophaa akkamii akkas jedhanii Ispeenichaa 'estoy trabajando aquí desde 2010' jechuu hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. Afaan Ingiliffaa gatiin, hojii kun galgalaa jiraachuu barbaachisaa ta'e hojii keessatti malee hin jiru, present perfect yookiin present perfect continuous hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a. 'Was working' jechuu hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, hojii keessatti hojjechuu hin danda'u. Hanga qorophaa akkamii akkas jechuuf, 'since' fi 'for' jechuu present perfect (yookiin perfect continuous) hojii keessatti hojjechuu danda'a, progressive simple hin kennamne.

title: Advanced Passives / Gaaffiiwwan Adda
bridge: Afaan Oromo, fogaatiin ‘in nisaan’ jew ‘in mala’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee, akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee, akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee, akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee. Afaan Ingilizii, mana qofaatni ‘it is said that’, ‘it is believed that’, jew ‘is said to be’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee. Akkasumas, afaan Oromootti ‘there’ jechuun hin qabdu akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii, gaaffiiwwan adda kanarraa hojjetan malee, akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee. Lamaani hanga: 1) Gaaffiiwwan shahhu: ‘Subject + passive verb + to-infinitive’ (e.g., ‘He is said to be very rich’). Dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee, akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee. 2) Gaaffiiwwan hin shahhu: ‘It + passive verb + that-clause’ (e.g., ‘It is believed that the economy will improve’). Kana malees, ‘There + passive verb + to be’ (e.g., ‘There is said to be a shortage of water’) jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

concept_examples.text: It is believed that the company will announce new plans soon.
concept_examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈliːvd ðæt ðə ˈkʌmpəni wɪl əˈnaʊns nuː plænz suːn/

concept_examples.text: The suspect is alleged to have stolen the money.
concept_examples.translation: Innisaan, dubbii qabduu kan biraa dhorgama hin bara.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsʌspekt ɪz əˈlɛdʒd tə hæv ˈstoʊlən ðə ˈmʌni/

concept_examples.text: There is said to be a hidden treasure in the old castle.
concept_examples.translation: Innisaan, mana baasuu kan biraa mana danda’u hin jiru.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz sɛd tə bi ə ˈhɪdən ˈtrɛʒər ɪn ði oʊld ˈkæsəl/

concept_examples.text: The new policy is expected to reduce costs significantly.
concept_examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə nuː ˈpɑləsi ɪz ɪkˈspɛktɪd tə rɪˈdus kɔsts sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/

common_error.wrong: It is said that there is a problem with the system.
common_error.correct: There is said to be a problem with the system.
common_error.correct_alt: It is said that the system has a problem.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromo nyaataa, ‘it is said that’ fi ‘there is’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee. Afaan Ingilizii, haa akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee, ‘there + passive + to be’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: It is estimated that over a million people visit the site each year.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɛstəmeɪtɪd ðæt ˈoʊvər ə ˈmɪljən ˈpiːpəl ˈvɪzɪt ðə saɪt iːtʃ jɪr/
examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: ‘It’ + gaaffiiwwan (olitti ‘estimated’, ‘believed’, ‘said’) + fogaatiin ‘that’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: It is thought that the election results will be close.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz θɔt ðæt ði ɪˈlɛkʃən rɪˈzʌlts wɪl bi kloʊs/
examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: Afaan Oromo, ‘innisaan’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee; afaan Ingilizii, gaaffiiwwan hin shahhu jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: It has been reported that the company is planning to expand.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt hæz bɪn rɪˈpɔrtɪd ðæt ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪz ˈplænɪŋ tə ɪkˈspænd/
examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: Gaaffiiwwan dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee (‘has been reported’) jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: The mayor is considered to be the most influential person in the city.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmeɪər ɪz kənˈsɪdərd tə bi ðə moʊst ˌɪnfluˈɛnʃəl ˈpɜrsən ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: ‘Consider’ jechuun ‘to be’ fi baafacha jew ajjeesaa malee.

examples.original: The ancient building is said to have been built in the 12th century.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˈeɪnʃənt ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪz sɛd tə hæv bɪn bɪlt ɪn ðə twɛlfθ ˈsɛnʧəri/
examples.translation: Innisaan, mana baasuu kan biraa mana danda’u hin jiru.
examples.note: Harka dhaabbataa, ‘to have been + past participle’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: The children are believed to be hiding in the forest.

examples.translation: Innisaan, illomoota dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: Harka bara dhaabbataa, ‘to be + gerund’ (qooda bara) jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: There are thought to be serious problems with the current system.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑr θɔt tə bi ˈsɪriəs ˈprɑbləmz wɪð ðə ˈkɜrənt ˈsɪstəm/
examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: ‘There are thought to be’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: The new law is claimed to have reduced crime by 30%.

examples.translation: Innisaan, qorophii bilisummaa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: ‘Claim’, ‘allege’, ‘report’ jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.

examples.original: He is known to have worked for the government in the past.

examples.translation: Innisaan, sirrii baasuu kan biraa dhaabbataa hojii ga’ee jira.
examples.note: ‘Known’ jechuun ‘to have + past participle’ harka dhaabbataa jechuun akkas haasa’aa fi hin argamsiisu dubbii qabdu kanarraa hojjetan malee.
